sourceFacts.storeyDescriptions: Architect/Arcam describe nine lower levels and twenty shaft levels; Arcam gives36 overall, the operator brochure35. Counts use differing conventions and are not silently reconciled.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Static medium-fi exterior preserves the original641134-triangle detailed draft and supplies a separately reviewed canopy/column source correction plus four complete browser levels. Published135m roof and150m tip are retained. 3DBAG2023 horizontal roof datums are approximate (1.10mRMSE and104/203 flags), not fabrication drawings. Thirty-five/36floor conventions and3.4mtypical versus3.49minterpolated shaft pitch remain unresolved. Granite joints, window returns, canopy dimensions, beacon and parked crane are reconstructed. Four corner crown towers use three proportional intervals rather than treating Arcam four-storey description as a measured floor plan. Hidden interiors, basement, neighboring towers, landscape, lighting animations and street furniture are excluded. Local host pavement fitting is required; terrain-contact preview is not a sidewalk survey and footprint replacement is disabled.

reconstruction.facade: Window modules and open gallery count are inferred from inspected full-resolution architecture-centre photographs. Cladding joints, transoms, stone thickness, louver pitch, canopy and door dimensions are original proportional reconstruction.
reconstruction.envelope: Roof datums use retained 3DBAG horizontal surfaces. Irregular LiDAR-derived polygons are not imported as a finished model. Twenty shaft intervals interpolate measured envelope datums; their3.49mmean differs from the published3.4mtypical floor pitch and awaits floor-elevation drawings.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X east-northeast along the BAG rear wall
nativeAxes.origin: Center of the BAG ground-envelope rectangle; Y0 uses terrain contact. The upper shaft is offset0.36m east and0.10m south in this frame. Native+X east-northeast follows the retained BAG rear edge; native+Z south-southeast faces Amstelplein entrance. Arcam explicitly describes the southern canopy/entrance. Inspected north-up satellite shows canopy at that side; November2020 panorama from52.3447836,4.9175248 looking337.11degrees shows the projecting glazed canopy and five columns. Retained RD-to-WGS84 operation accuracy1m; heading0.3589785079857852rad is a mapped/photo reconstruction with approximately3degree uncertainty, not surveyed azimuth.

appearance.identity: Amsterdam’s granite-clad Rembrandt Tower: stepped cross-shaped podium, fourteen-bay facades with deeply recessed glazed corners, seven-bay open crown galleries, four glazed corner towers, a cross-shaped mechanical cap, ringed beacon and parked maintenance crane. The southern entrance has three revolving doors and a projecting canopy.
appearance.master: Source-local glazed canopy/five-column correction; untouched original draft remains reproducible.
appearance.browser: Complete stepped cross podium, recessed shaft corners, four glazed crown towers, open gallery, cross cap, ringed beacon, parked crane and entrance at every level.
